title: Studio Content Engine Control Tower

reasons: The operator asked how to turn Studio into a usable content-to-slideshow and prompt workflow.
The request includes broad product-quality language and spans UI, prompt storage, character reuse, guardrails, output adjustment, content handoff, and a potential AI-video vendor.
External AI-video work requires a provider setup packet before any adapter or external write.
likely_external_provider_blockers: AI-video vendor API contract is unknown.
Real video generation, upload, publication, Drive write, Vimeo write, send, payment, or access grant is not approved by this packet.
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: Generate and run 01-current-state-studio-audit for /operations?view=studio with a scoped TEST Studio project.

operator_intent_summary: Make the private Studio section usable as an actual One Time Mishnah content engine where source material can become reviewable slideshows, prompt packs, reusable character/guardrail libraries, prompt patches, and eventually AI-video handoff outputs.

decisions_captured.decision: AI-video vendor adapter scope is not yet approved; capture vendor API/output/cost/rights details first.

out_of_scope: No Studio product-code implementation in this control packet.

No live render, upload, publish, send, schedule, payment, access grant, Drive write, Vimeo write, WhatsApp action, Telegram action, DNS change, GHL runtime, LeadConnector reference, external CRM write, hard delete, secret exposure, or raw private evidence.
No final character or Jewish guardrail copy invented without operator/source approval.

inspection_targets: Studio domain compiler and mock job code
focused Studio tests and browser smoke
known_blockers: Current Studio output is deterministic/mock and mostly internal-review oriented.
Compiled prompt and job readbacks are shown as raw code/JSON blocks.
Live authenticated write smoke was not run in this packet.
AI-video vendor contract and credentials are not defined.

expanded_phrases.million-dollar: Studio must feel founder-demo-quality: clear IA, polished review cards, no raw debug-first UX, durable prompt/character libraries, action states, mobile proof, accessibility, tests, deploy, and live authenticated smoke.
expanded_phrases.make it work: A scoped TEST Studio project must complete source intake, storyboard, prompt compile, correction patch, mock/render preview, and no-send Content handoff with visible readbacks and no silent failures.
expanded_phrases.working: Every visible Studio action must either perform its first-party local behavior, show preview-only status, or show a named blocker with owner and next action.
expanded_phrases.live: App-visible Studio work is not terminal done until deployed and live-smoked through authenticated Operations without external publish/send/upload.
expanded_phrases.clean: Compiled prompts and job payloads should render as polished review surfaces with diagnostics hidden behind an explicit control instead of default raw code blocks.
expanded_phrases.pipeline: Studio workflow means a scoped source moves through explicit first-party stages: source intake, storyboard, prompt compile, correction patch, mock or approved adapter job, review, and no-send Content handoff with provenance and action-state readback.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: Studio remains first-party BNA Operations. External AI-video systems can be provider adapters only after a separate setup packet; no GHL or external CRM runtime is involved.

External AI-video work is separated into a provider setup packet.
